thread.title: Q2 2019 Earnings Estimate for Apple Inc. Issued By Wedbush (AAPL)

author: Kayla Sanchez
title: Q2 2019 Earnings Estimate for Apple Inc. Issued By Wedbush (AAPL)
text:
Filed Under: Finance
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) – Equities research analysts at Wedbush reduced their Q2 2019 earnings per share estimates for shares of Apple in a report issued on Wednesday, January 30th. Wedbush analyst D. Ives now forecasts that the iPhone maker will post earnings of $2.45 per share for the quarter, down from their previous estimate of $2.85. Wedbush currently has a “Outperform” rating and a $200.00 price target on the stock. Wedbush also issued estimates for Apple’s FY2020 earnings at $13.10 EPS. Get Apple alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Tuesday, January 29th. The iPhone maker reported $4.18 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $4.17 by $0.01. Apple had a return on equity of 51.09% and a net margin of 22.72%. The company had revenue of $84.31 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $84.07 billion. AAPL has been the topic of a number of other research reports. JPMorgan Chase & Co. restated a “buy” rating and issued a $272.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 10th. BidaskClub lowered Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a report on Wednesday, November 28th. HSBC lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $181.37 price target on the stock. in a report on Sunday, December 9th. Needham & Company LLC dropped their price target on Apple from $200.00 to $180.00 and set a “buy” rating on the stock in a report on Thursday, January 3rd. Finally, Sanford C. Bernstein reiterated a “neutral” rating and set a $210.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, November 2nd. Three investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have assigned a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the stock. Apple currently has a consensus rating of “Hold” and a consensus price target of $191.66.
AAPL stock opened at $166.44 on Friday. Apple has a twelve month low of $142.00 and a twelve month high of $233.47. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12. The company has a market capitalization of $812.23 billion, a PE ratio of 13.97, a P/E/G ratio of 1.61 and a beta of 1.23.
The business also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 14th. Stockholders of record on Monday, February 11th will be given a $0.73 dividend. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a dividend yield of 1.75%. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Friday, February 8th. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is presently 24.52%.
In other news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares in the company, valued at $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is available through the SEC website . 0.05% of the stock is currently owned by insiders.
A number of institutional investors have recently bought and sold shares of AAPL. Cornerstone Wealth Management LLC grew its position in Apple by 18,553.3% during the second quarter. Cornerstone Wealth Management LLC now owns 16,758,709 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $89,526,000 after buying an additional 16,668,866 shares in the last quarter. Morgan Stanley boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 9.7% in the 3rd quarter. Morgan Stanley now owns 39,188,032 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $8,846,307,000 after purchasing an additional 3,452,792 shares in the last quarter. Janus Henderson Group PLC boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 18.8% in the 3rd quarter. Janus Henderson Group PLC now owns 20,833,222 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,703,027,000 after purchasing an additional 3,293,674 shares in the last quarter. Royal London Asset Management Ltd. purchased a new position in shares of Apple in the 2nd quarter worth about $385,873,000. Finally, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Holdings Inc. boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 6.5% in the 2nd quarter. Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Holdings Inc. now owns 17,008,496 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,148,443,000 after purchasing an additional 1,030,981 shares in the last quarter. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 57.02% of the company’s stock.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
